第1574章 劫灭诸世1（第1页）
三灾九难第一灾非同小可，若是能够成功渡过杨凡的修为便会突飞猛进，若是失败的话，基本上就代表着死亡。
原本现在正是大战的时候，并不是渡劫的好时机。
渡劫，需要不被人打扰，选择在一个安静的地方全心神对抗雷劫，这样渡劫的成功率才会高一些，不过现在杨凡也没有别的办法了。
屠龙部落与妖族联军现如今面临着极其之大的危机，一旦等到万族攻破阵线，到时候这些人能够幸存下来的估计没有几人。
所以必须想对策了，而杨凡引劫降临似乎便是他能够想到的唯一方法。
当初十二阴灵古魔渡劫的场景杨凡记忆犹新，太过于可怕了，七道雷劫连人形闪电都给引下来了，毁天灭地一般，让他心惊肉跳的。
自己的积蓄则是同等级修士的二百倍，一旦将雷劫引下来将会多么可怕？这简直就无法想象，到时候将万族的修士笼罩在雷劫之中，又有几个人能够从那降落的雷劫轰击之下活下去呢？
就算能够活下来的人，也有很大的可能被杨凡的雷劫将他们自身的雷劫提前引下来。
雷劫提前降临，本身还没有做好对抗雷劫的准备，到时候可以想象，后果绝对好不了哪里去。
当然，杨凡引动雷劫将这么多人笼罩在雷劫的范围之内，必然也会增加他雷劫的威力。
雷劫威力增加，对杨凡可不是什么好事，会让他渡过雷劫的几率再次的降低。
“杨凡，你死定了！今日你的头颅宇文元天取定了”。宇文元天冷笑连连，对于杨凡，他只有冷漠的杀机。
现如今形势危急，杨凡哪会理会宇文元天此人，你现在是牛逼，待会雷劫下来的时候看你还牛逼不？
他转头说道，“我也要渡劫了，三灾九难第一灾，我现在引动雷劫，当雷云出现的时候，你们快点退出这片区域”。
“渡劫？现在渡劫吗？可并不是好时候”。公孙大牛说道。
公孙老族长也道，“小友是想要雷劫对抗万族这些人吗？虽说可以对万族这些人造成一定的杀伤，但并不能挫其筋骨，而且会将自己置身于危险之中，小友万万不可啊”。
屠龙部落的人七嘴八舌的劝阻了起来，龟祖却道，“好主意，渡雷劫的确是现如今我们能够选择的最好办法了，你们放心，这一次我们很可能让万族这些人吃不了兜子走，千万不要小看杨凡这小子啊，他的积蓄是同等级修士的二百倍，一旦渡雷劫，特别还是三灾九难的第一灾，那威力是难以想象的”。

三灾九难第一灾本身就比别的雷劫强大十倍甚至十几倍，几十倍，而杨凡的积蓄又是同等级修士的二百倍，他所要渡的雷劫那就更加没有办法想象了。
听到龟祖的话，公孙老族长等人也都一阵咋舌。
同等级修士的二百倍？这……也太变态了吧？
杨凡知道现在情况紧急，所以也不敢耽搁时间，他眉心处晶莹剔透，劫数的气息与力量交织。
一道劫光从杨凡的眉心处冲天而起，冲入了九霄之中，贯穿天地。
轰隆隆的巨响之声随之响彻起来，在九天之上，雷云缭绕，出现了一片片的雷云汪洋。
那些雷云，交织出神华，璀璨夺目，淀放出神光，雷劫的气息弥漫在九天之上，乌云开始出现，在乌云之中，夹杂着雷霆的力量，仔细望去，在乌云的深处，有一座雷霆的海洋，那座雷霆海洋延伸进入周围的虚空之中，长不知道多少万里，在雷霆海洋之中竟然有一头头足有千丈之长的巨龙在翱翔天地。
这便是杨凡引动下来的雷劫，惊动了所有人。
不论是屠龙部落，妖族的人，还是万族的人都仰头朝着上方望去。
屠龙部落、妖族这一方事先已经知道杨凡的打算，所以当雷劫出现的时候，他们便已经快速的退了出去。
万族的那些人还没有反应过来，第一道雷劫已经开始酝酿出来。

Chapter 1574 Destruction of the Worlds 1 (Page 1)
The first of the three disasters and the nine disasters is no small matter. If he can successfully survive it, Yang Fan's cultivation will improve by leaps and bounds. If he fails, it basically means death.
Originally, now was the time for a war, not a good time to overcome the calamity.
To overcome the tribulation, you need to not be disturbed by others and choose to fight against the thunder tribulation in a quiet place with all your heart. This way, the success rate of overcoming the tribulation will be higher, but now Yang Fan has no other way.
The Dragon-Slaying Tribe and the Monster Clan Alliance are now facing an extremely big crisis. Once all the tribes break through, it is estimated that not many of these people will survive.
So he had to think of countermeasures, and Yang Fan seemed to be the only way he could think of to bring disaster down.
The scene of the Twelve Yin Spirit Ancient Demons going through the tribulation was still fresh in Yang Fan's memory. It was too terrifying. The seven thunder tribulations even brought down human-shaped lightning, destroying the sky and destroying the earth, which made him terrified.
My savings are 200 times that of monks of the same level. How terrible will it be once the thunder tribulation is brought down? It is simply unimaginable that when the monks of all races are enveloped in thunder and calamity, how many people will be able to survive the bombardment of the thunder and calamity that lands?
Even those who can survive are very likely to be triggered by Yang Fan's thunder tribulation to prevent their own thunder tribulation in advance.
The thunder tribulation came early, and I was not ready to fight against the thunder tribulation. It is conceivable that the consequences would not be much better.
Of course, Yang Fan's triggering of thunder tribulation and covering so many people within the range of thunder tribulation will inevitably increase the power of his thunder tribulation.
The increased power of the thunder tribulation is not a good thing for Yang Fan, as it will reduce his chances of surviving the thunder tribulation again.
"Yang Fan, you are dead! Your head will be taken by Yuwen Yuantian today." Yuwen Yuantian sneered again and again. For Yang Fan, he only had cold murderous intent.
Now that the situation is critical, how can Yang Fan pay attention to Yuwen Yuantian? You are awesome now. Will you still be awesome when the thunder tribulation comes down?
He turned around and said, "I am also going to overcome the tribulation. The first of the three disasters and nine disasters, I will trigger the thunder tribulation now. When the thunder cloud appears, you must exit this area quickly."
"Overcoming the tribulation? Overcoming the tribulation now? This is not a good time." Gongsun Daniu said.
Elder Gongsun Patriarch also said, "Do you want Thunder Tribulation to fight against people like Wanzu? Although it can cause certain damage to people like Wanzu, it can't break their bones, and it will put yourself in danger. You must not do it."
The people of the Dragon Slaying Tribe tried to dissuade him, but Guizu said, "What a great idea. Overcoming the Thunder Tribulation is indeed the best way we can choose now. Don't worry, this time we will probably make it difficult for people like Wanzu to leave. Don't underestimate Yang Fan. His savings are 200 times that of monks of the same level. Once the Thunder Tribulation is overcome, especially the first of the three disasters and nine disasters, the power is unimaginable."
The first of the three disasters and the nine disasters itself is ten times or even ten times or dozens of times more powerful than other thunder catastrophes, and Yang Fan's savings are two hundred times that of monks of the same level. The thunder catastrophe he has to overcome is even more unimaginable.
Hearing Gui Zu's words, Patriarch Gongsun and others were also speechless.
Two hundred times that of a monk of the same level? Isn't this... too perverted?
Yang Fan knew that the situation was urgent, so he did not dare to waste time. The center of his eyebrows was crystal clear, and the aura of doom and power were intertwined.
A ray of calamity light soared into the sky from Yang Fan's eyebrows, rushed into the sky, and penetrated the heaven and earth.
A loud rumbling sound then resounded, and thunderclouds lingered above the nine heavens, and vast oceans of thunderclouds appeared.
ThatSome thunder clouds intertwined with divine flowers, dazzling the eyes, and the lake released divine light. The aura of thunder tribulation filled the nine heavens, and dark clouds began to appear. Among the dark clouds, there was the power of thunder. Looking carefully, in the depths of the dark clouds, there was a sea of ​​thunder. The sea of ​​thunder extended into the surrounding void, and it was thousands of miles long. In the sea of ​​thunder, there was a giant dragon with a head of thousands of feet long soaring through the sky and the earth.
This was the thunder disaster caused by Yang Fan, which shocked everyone.
Whether it was the Dragon Slaying Tribe, people from the Monster Clan, or people from all races, they all raised their heads and looked upward.
The dragon-slaying tribe and the demon tribe already knew Yang Fan's plan in advance, so when the thunder tribulation appeared, they had already retreated quickly.
Before the people of Wanzu could react, the first thunder disaster had already begun to brew.
